currentParagraphText: “Oh,” Jake exclaimed. Why or how the Seeker had storage concerns, he decided not to ask, as he feared the answer would be a lot longer and more boring than Jake cared for.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Oh,” Jake exclaimed. Why or how the Seeker had storage concerns, he decided not to ask, as he feared the answer would be a lot longer and more boring than Jake cared for.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Cubes!” Jasper said happily as he threw his summoned cube up and down a few times before it began to turn transparent, and a few seconds later, it entirely disappeared.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “They’re the easiest to stack and the most space-efficient way to store anything,” the Seeker said. “I tried spheres, but they waste too much space between them when stacked together.”
